headline: Santos Trims Upper Production Forecast Due to Pikka Disruptions
summary: Australian energy producer Santos trimmed the upper end of its annual volume forecast following operational disruptions at its Pikka project, causing its shares to fall.
why: Santos is a major Australian oil and gas exploration and production company listed on the ASX.

impacts.name: Santos Ltd
impacts.why: Lowering production guidance directly reduces projected revenue and cash flows for the fiscal year.

why_moved: Downward revisions to production guidance signal lower operational output, prompting investors to reprice the stock downward.
